```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  secrets-diagnostics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@93cb6efe18208431cddfb8368fd83d5badbf9bfd # v5.0.1

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@0a158c87d85004611215362200643413410312d0 # v5.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: |
          golangci-lint run ./...

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -v -timeout=3m -tags '!integration' -run='^Test' ./...

      - name: Verify token fallback chain implementation
        run: |
          # Check that getEffectiveAgentGitHubToken has proper fallback chain
          if ! grep -r "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN.*GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN.*GITHUB_TOKEN" . --include="*.go"; then
            echo "Error: Token fallback chain not found in source code"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Check that callers pass full token chain
          if ! grep -r "getEffectiveAgentGitHubToken.*toplevelToken" . --include="*.go"; then
            echo "Error: Callers not passing full token chain"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Verify campaign-generator.lock.yml has updated assign-to-agent step
          if ! grep -A5 -B5 "assign-to-agent" .github/aw/actions-lock.json; then
            echo "Warning: Could not verify assign-to-agent step in lock file"
          fi

          echo "All checks passed!"
```
